address: Plot 42, Near Datta Mandir, Saiful, Jule Solapur
title: Low water pressure and erratic supply timing
description: For the past 4 days, our lane in Saiful has been receiving water for only 15 minutes with extremely low pressure. Many residents are forced to buy private tankers. Please inspect the main distribution pipeline.
assignedOfficer: Er. S. M. Shinde (Junior Engineer - Water Works)
officerRemarks: Valve team inspected the distribution line near Datta Mandir. Air blockage detected in 150mm pipeline. Flushing and valve replacement in progress.

timeline.title: Grievance Registered

timeline.title: Grievance Acknowledged

timeline.title: Assigned to Ward Officer
timeline.description: Assigned to Er. S. M. Shinde (Junior Engineer - Water Works, Zone 2).

timeline.title: Field Action Initiated
timeline.description: Inspection completed. Valve repair and pipeline pressure correction underway.

address: Near Vegetable Market Corner, Bhavani Peth
title: Garbage bin overflowing near market entry
description: Garbage collection truck has not cleared the municipal bin near the vegetable market entrance for 3 days. Stray cattle and dogs are scattering waste onto the street, causing foul smell and hygiene risk.

address: Opposite Urdu Primary School, Ashok Chowk
title: Sewage manhole overflowing onto pedestrian walkway
description: Drain chamber is blocked and contaminated black water is overflowing onto the school pedestrian approach road. Pungent odor and health hazard for school children.
officerRemarks: Suction jetting machine deployed to Ashok Chowk chamber. Heavy silt and plastic obstruction extracted. Chamber cleared and closed with secure concrete lid.
